session.disclaimer: This is an educational simulation, not emergency guidance. FloodGuard is a simplified teaching game. Its water levels, outcomes and scores are invented and are not a flood forecast or a real-world plan. Characters are fictional and AI-generated text can be wrong. If you are in a real emergency or a flood is happening near you, stop playing and call 112 (India emergency number). Follow instructions from your local authorities and official sources for your area (for example the India Meteorological Department, the Central Water Commission and your State Disaster Management Authority). Do not rely on this game for decisions about evacuation, safety or health.

cited_rulecards.title: Safe Shelter Operations
cited_rulecards.guidance: Designate and unlock multi-story masonry public buildings on elevated ground as relief shelters before evacuees arrive to ensure orderly intake and security.

cited_rulecards.title: Dam Release Communication
cited_rulecards.guidance: Downstream villages need advance notice before a dam release. Coordinate with the dam authority early; a slower, staggered release with clear warnings gives people time to move.
cited_rulecards.source_reference: Dam Safety and Downstream Warning Practice

cited_rulecards.title: Early Public Warning Protocol
cited_rulecards.guidance: Broadcast official evacuation advisories promptly when river forecasts suggest imminent bank overtopping. Early warnings give vulnerable families critical lead time to assemble emergency kits and move to higher ground.
